parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity rows for human SRC kinase (CHEMBL267). Start from docs to capture provenance (pubmed_id_or_doi). Join docs to activities on doc_id, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL267 and standard_type IC50. Join molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno and join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Left join compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
